# Divider

**Figma:** Divider (page 460:38357)  
**Import:** `import { Divider } from "@zen-ds/react";`

A 1px line that separates groups of content. Default (Pale) is the everyday rule; Medium and High add emphasis only when the design calls for it.

## Use it for
- Between groups of rows, settings sections or list blocks.
- Between toolbar groups (vertical, decorative).
- Under a total or summary line (High).

## Use something else for
- Framing a box → a container border (Subtle if actionable, Pale if static).
- Separating every row of a table → row rules in the table itself.
- Adding space → use spacing tokens, not an empty line.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Color | `color` | default (Border/Neutral/Pale) · medium (Subtle) · high (Solid) |
| Orientation | `orientation` | horizontal (<hr>) · vertical (role=separator) |
| Dashed | `dashed` | a Default dashed line steps up to Subtle |
| Decorative | `decorative` | aria-hidden, for purely visual separation |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/divider.json`.

### Divider
Figma Divider (460:38361): a 1px INSIDE stroke line. Default (Pale) is the everyday rule; Medium (Subtle) and High (Solid) add emphasis only when the design calls for it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `"default" \| "medium" \| "high"` | `"default"` | Figma Color: Default → Border/Neutral/Pale · Medium → Subtle · High → Solid. |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` |  |
| `dashed` | `boolean` | `false` | Dashed line; a Default dashed line steps up to Border/Neutral/Subtle (Pale is too faint when dashed). |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | Purely visual: hidden from assistive tech (e.g. between toolbar groups that are already labelled). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

## ✅ Do
- Use the Default color unless the design explicitly needs more emphasis.
- Reserve High for the one line that closes a calculation (receipt totals).
- Mark toolbar and label separators decorative when the groups are already labelled.
- Let spacing do most of the grouping; add a divider only where groups would otherwise blur.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't stack two dividers or put one at the very top/bottom of a card (harness: divider/no-double).
- Don't use a divider as a container border.
- Don't draw dashed dividers in Pale — dashed steps up to Subtle automatically.

## Accessibility
- Horizontal renders `<hr>` (role separator); vertical renders role=separator with aria-orientation; decorative dividers are aria-hidden.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `divider/no-double` | warn | One divider between two groups — never two Dividers in a row. | `zen-allow-double-divider: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
